title: registry.yml
description: Node-RED instance inventory. Field reference: docs/registry.md

global_variables.description: Environment shared by every instance; per-instance variables override it.

name.description: Unique across the registry, and the --instance argument. Host-qualified, because six hosts each run a service called node-red-prod.

host.description: Must appear in the Jenkins host map.

compose_service.description: Service name for `docker compose up -d <service>`. Never call compose without it — the file may hold other services.

compose_file.description: Absolute path to the compose file on that host. It differs per host and is not derivable from the host name, so the palette recreate needs it stored.

app.description: Directory under apps/, or null for an instance with no flow of its own.

admin_root.description: httpAdminRoot as the instance actually answers on it. Empty string means the API is at /flows. Any other value starts with / and does not end with one.

auth_credential_id.description: Jenkins credential holding the adminAuth user and password.

credential_secret_id.description: Jenkins credential holding this instance's pinned credentialSecret.

image_tag.description: Exact Harbor tag. A floating tag drifts silently across hosts and is rejected.
